Real `qrsh -inherit` stderr signatures captured on OCS 9.0.10 (see memory ocs-test-cluster).
Used to ground classifyRejection. One signature per block.

# FATAL - misconfiguration, not retryable (no JOB_ID in env: preflight/wiring bug)
error: "qrsh" called with option "-inherit", but "JOB_ID" not set in environment

# RETRYABLE (job race, SI-09) - slave execd has not yet learned of the job, or rejects the task
error: executing task of job 999999 failed: execution daemon on host "ocs-worker1" didn't accept task

# FATAL - missing SGE_TASK_ID (misconfiguration)
error: executing task of job 999999 failed: missing "SGE_TASK_ID" in environment

# RETRYABLE (slot exhaustion, SI-55) - NOT captured live (needs a real over-slot PE job);
# pattern below is the documented GE wording and MUST be confirmed against a live over-slot
# rejection before relying on it. Kept conservative so a miss falls through to the race retry.
error: no suitable queues
